CancellationPolicy.title: Cancellation Policy
CancellationPolicy.description: Operator-defined booking cancellation policy: minimum notice for free cancellation, reschedule window, late-cancellation fee brackets, no-show fee, card-hold requirement, and refund method. Resolved at appointment-creation time and snapshot onto the appointment so historical bookings keep their original terms (design D2). Per REQ-BCR-001.

policyId.description: Stable operator-facing policy identifier, unique per administration.
policyId.title: Policy ID

name.description: Human-readable policy name shown in the admin policy list.
name.title: Name

description.description: Policy description shown to customers at booking and cancellation time.
description.example: 48-hour cancellation notice, 20% late fee after 48h, 100% no-show fee.
description.title: Description

minNoticeDays.description: Minimum whole days of notice for a free cancellation (0 = same-day allowed). Per REQ-BCR-001.
minNoticeDays.title: Min Notice Days

rescheduleWindowDays.description: Number of days after the original start time within which a cancelled appointment MAY be rescheduled (T2 enforcement).
rescheduleWindowDays.title: Reschedule Window Days

lateFeeBrackets.description: Ordered fee brackets. The matching bracket is the one with the largest daysBeforeStart that is still <= the actual whole days until start (design D3). feeType is percentage or fixed; feeAmount is a percentage (0-100) or a fixed amount in integer cents.

daysBeforeStart.description: Whole-day threshold; bracket applies when daysUntilStart >= daysBeforeStart.
daysBeforeStart.title: Days Before Start

feeType.description: percentage = feeAmount is a 0-100 percentage of the appointment cost; fixed = feeAmount is an amount in integer cents.
feeType.title: Fee Type

feeAmount.description: Percentage (0-100) when feeType=percentage, or amount in integer cents when feeType=fixed.
feeAmount.title: Fee Amount

lateFeeBrackets.title: Late Fee Brackets

noShowFee.description: Fee applied when the customer does not show. Percentage (0-100) of appointment cost; interpreted by the policy's no-show feeType convention. Per REQ-BCR-001.
noShowFee.title: No Show Fee

cardHoldRequired.description: Whether a card hold is required at booking (declared in phase 2; enforced in phase 3 payment integration).
cardHoldRequired.title: Card Hold Required

refundPolicy.description: How refunds are issued. Recorded in phase 2; executed by phase 3 payment integration.
refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy

linkedService.description: Optional FK to Service.serviceId (bookings-service-catalog). Declared for T2 service-specific policy selection; phase 2 ships global policy resolution (design D7).
linkedService.title: Linked Service

lifecycleState.description: Policy lifecycle. Archived policies are hidden from new-appointment resolution but kept for audit and historical snapshots.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

active.label: Active
active.description: Policy is available for resolution onto new appointments.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Policy is retired; not offered for new appointments. Existing snapshots are unaffected.

archive.label: Archive policy
archive.description: Soft-delete the policy. Historical appointments retain their snapshot of the policy terms.

reactivate.label: Reactivate policy
reactivate.description: Return an archived policy to active so it can be resolved onto new appointments again.

operator.description: Operators manage cancellation policies for their administration.

customer.description: Customers may read the policy terms applicable to their bookings.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Cancellation Policy is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

BookingCancellation.title: Booking Cancellation
BookingCancellation.description: Immutable cancellation record for an appointment. Captures the cancellation timestamp, reason, the policy snapshot that applied, the calculated refund amount, and the refund lifecycle. One per cancelled appointment; a second cancellation of the same appointment MUST be rejected (REQ-BCR-008 immutability). The appointmentId FK targets the Appointment register declared by the bookings-create-appointment fragment (10-bookings-create-appointment.json); the x-openregister-relation below resolves it.

appointmentId.description: Identifier of the cancelled appointment (FK to Appointment.appointmentId).
appointmentId.title: Appointment ID

cancelledAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the cancellation was recorded (design D8). Immutable once set.
cancelledAt.title: Cancelled At

cancelledReason.description: Reason enum (design D5). Immutable; set at cancellation time.
cancelledReason.title: Cancelled Reason

cancelledBy.description: Actor that initiated the cancellation (admin user id or 'customer:<email>'). Recorded for audit (REQ-BCR-007).
cancelledBy.title: Cancelled By

notes.description: Optional free-text note supplied at cancellation time.
notes.title: Notes

appliedPolicy.description: Snapshot of the CancellationPolicy terms in force at appointment creation time (design D2): policyId, minNoticeDays, lateFeeBrackets, noShowFee, refundPolicy. Used for fee calculation so later policy edits do not alter historical bookings.
appliedPolicy.title: Applied Policy

appointmentCost.description: Appointment cost in integer cents at cancellation time, used as the base for fee calculation.
appointmentCost.title: Appointment Cost

cancellationFeeApplied.description: Fee withheld in integer cents (appointmentCost - refundAmount).
cancellationFeeApplied.title: Cancellation Fee Applied

refundAmount.description: Amount eligible for refund in integer cents = appointmentCost - fee, never negative (design D4).
refundAmount.title: Refund Amount

refundStatus.description: Refund lifecycle (design D6). Set to pending on cancellation; transitioned by phase 3 payment integration.
refundStatus.title: Refund Status

refundedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the refund completed (set in phase 3).
refundedAt.title: Refunded At

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Cancellation recorded; refund not yet processed.

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: Refund attempt failed; customer must contact support (phase 3).

process.label: Mark refund processed
process.description: Phase 3 payment integration completed the refund.

fail.label: Mark refund failed
fail.description: Phase 3 payment integration could not complete the refund.

cancelRefund.label: Cancel refund
cancelRefund.description: Refund was cancelled before processing (edge case).

operator.description: Operators record and view cancellations. No delete: cancellation records are immutable (REQ-BCR-008).

customer.description: Customers may self-cancel their own appointments and read the resulting record.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Booking Cancellation is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

Appointment.description: Partial overlay (ADR-037 additive merge) onto the Appointment register owned by the bookings-create-appointment fragment (10-bookings-create-appointment.json). Adds the phase-2 cancellation fields the cancellation flow snapshots onto an appointment when it is cancelled (REQ-BCR Appointment Schema Extensions). These fields are all optional — set only at cancellation time — so they are deliberately NOT added to the base schema's required list. The base schema already declares cancelledAt and cancelledReason.

appliedPolicy.description: Snapshot of the CancellationPolicy terms in force at appointment-creation time (design D2): policyId, minNoticeDays, lateFeeBrackets, noShowFee, refundPolicy. Used for fee calculation so later policy edits do not alter historical bookings.
appliedPolicy.title: Applied Policy

appointmentCost.description: Appointment cost in integer cents, used as the base for cancellation-fee calculation (design D4).
appointmentCost.title: Appointment Cost

refundAmount.description: Amount eligible for refund in integer cents = appointmentCost - fee, never negative (design D4). Set at cancellation.
refundAmount.title: Refund Amount

refundStatus.description: Refund lifecycle (design D6). Set to pending on cancellation; transitioned by phase 3 payment integration.
refundStatus.title: Refund Status

refundedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the refund completed (set in phase 3).
refundedAt.title: Refunded At
